canonical_name: Incredible Business Networking (IBN) - East Asheville chapter
summary: A free, drop-in monthly business networking lunch run by Incredible Towns of WNC, normally held the first Tuesday of the month (recently at Red Lobster on Tunnel Road, currently seeking a new venue). Its own promotional copy states it is 'open to all, with never any dues, fees, restrictions, exclusions, or membership requirements' - you just show up and buy lunch. This matches the finding for the sibling IBN chapters (Woodfin, Asheville West, Brevard/Pisgah Forest): a rotating public of local business people rather than a fixed membership.

evidence.note: Listing descriptions are generic and identical across the 3 events shown, with no membership, dues, or named-regulars language - just 'casual conversation, referrals, and community updates'.

Tags include 'Venue Change Pending' and 'Meeting Relocation'; the chapter has been searching for a new host venue since mid-2026, consistent with an informal drop-in meetup rather than an organization with a stable home base.
Search snippet from Incredible Towns' own IBN page: events are 'no cost to attend and open to all, with no attendance requirements, fees, dues or exclusions' - explicitly not a membership model.

Search snippet describes the East Asheville chapter specifically: meets 1st Tuesday monthly, 'open to all, with never any dues, fees, restrictions, exclusions, or membership requirements. You just buy your lunch if you are hungry.'
IBN's regional presence is a single WNC-wide Facebook group covering all chapters, not a dedicated East Asheville chapter page or roster.
